title: Filing a Hardship Request on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Account
content:
**Policy.** A borrower facing job loss, medical hardship, a natural disaster or reduced income files the hardship request themselves, stating the reason and the months of payment deferral asked for; a borrower who asks for the longest deferral available asks for the hardship offer, and the request records that number. For a hardship request the borrower files on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), and only for such a request, the plan must still offer deferral and the account must still be no more than the stated days past due, while the months the borrower may ask for are the hardship offer set out in this policy in place of the plan's maximum per deferral and the lifetime maximum less the months already used; how many of those months are granted, and how a request that fails a condition is declined, remain with the hardship deferral rules; a request on an account whose plan carries a promotion remains under the base hardship rules. The months asked on a request filed under this policy never exceed the hardship offer: a borrower who wants more is told the offer, and the request is filed for the offer. The plan attributes that give the most months one hardship deferral may cover and the most months of deferral over the life of the account describe the base hardship rules; for a request this policy covers, the per-request cap and the lifetime room set out in this policy govern.

## What filing records

The request is recorded against the Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account with the reason the borrower gives and the number of months of payment deferral asked for. It stands as a submitted request awaiting the lender's decision, and the borrower can see it on the account at once.

## Invocation

The tool is `submit_finance_hardship_request_30b3e3a9`. It is the borrower's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | The reference number of the financing account the request concerns, as returned by the financing account lookup | Identifier |
| `hardship_reason` | The reason the borrower gives for the hardship | Exactly one of the values below |
| `requested_months` | The months of payment deferral the borrower asks for | A non-negative integer count of whole months |

Values of `hardship_reason`:

- `job_loss` — the borrower or the household's earner has lost their job;
- `medical` — an illness, injury or medical treatment has stopped or cut the household's income;
- `natural_disaster` — a storm, flood, fire or other natural disaster has struck the home or the household's income;
- `reduced_income` — the household still works but its income has been cut, such as reduced hours or pay.

## Return

A successful filing returns a receipt with `finance_hardship_request_id` (the reference number of the new hardship request), `finance_account_id` (the account it concerns), `hardship_reason` (the reason recorded), `requested_months` (the months asked for) and `request_status` (the word submitted when the request has been recorded).
